messages:
Matt: Heads up — thinking about adding 'route cohorts' in Console analytics: let users pin a time-window (e.g., last 7d) and auto-save filter variants when drift is detected. Want to align on API contract and quota attribution before we mock up UI. :thinking_face:

Tara: Love the idea. Two quick concerns: 1) autosave could explode saved queries, 2) quota metrics — should cohort sampling count against route quota or a separate 'insights' bucket? :eyes:

Kevin: From infra side, prefer a separate 'insights' quota. Attribution per-route is expensive at scale. We can approximate by sampling and extrapolating. Also need an API flag to opt-in: `insights_charge: true/false`.

Sophia: Telemetry note — to detect drift we need stable baseline and feature-set hash per route. We should capture `route_signature` in metrics to avoid false positives.

Roni: UX thought — instead of auto-creating saved queries, maybe create 'draft variants' that live in a per-route sandbox. User can commit to saved query. Less noise.

Tara: Agreed. API sketch:
```
POST /api/1/routes/{route_id}/cohorts
{
  "name": "signup-cohort-7d",
  "time_pin": "7d",
  "filters": { "model": "redwood-4b", "intent": "checkout" },
  "autosave_policy": "draft|auto|off",
  "insights_charge": "true|false"
}
```

Kevin: Implementation note — when `autosave_policy=auto` create a draft, run drift-eval job, if > threshold create saved query and emit event `cohort:created` for billing. Keep retention 90d by default.

Sophia: Also add `sample_rate` param (default 1%) so teams can tune telemetry cost.

Matt: Nice. So consensus: draft-first UX, opt-in billing, sample-based drift detection, retention defaults. I'll update the design doc and ping legal for billing language. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:

deploy-bot: Added issue #4567 to the product backlog: 'route cohorts — API + draft autosave flow'.

Tara: I'll mock the console microflow tomorrow and drop screenshots.

Matt: Perfect — assigning to @tara and @kevin for next steps.
